# @valentinkolb/ssr (LLM Notes)

Minimal SSR + islands framework for SolidJS on Bun.

## Repository layout

Monorepo root:

- `packages/ssr-core` (library)
- `packages/ssr-example` (current Hono example)

## Core files

- `src/index.ts`
  - `createConfig()`
  - returns `{ config, plugin, html }`
  - injects hydration script
  - production hydration imports use `?v=<buildTimestamp>` cache busting

- `src/transform.ts`
  - Babel transform for SSR/DOM
  - wraps island/client component usage with `solid-island` / `solid-client`

- `src/island-id.ts`
  - stable file-path-based island IDs
  - avoids collisions across workspace packages

- `src/build.ts`
  - scans island/client files
  - bundles browser chunks into `_ssr`
  - hard-fails on ID collisions

- `src/adapter/*`
  - Bun, Hono, Elysia adapters
  - serve built chunks from `/_ssr/*.js`

## Conventions

- `*.island.tsx`: SSR + hydrated
- `*.client.tsx`: client-only
- `*.tsx`: server-only

## Monorepo support

`createConfig({ rootDir })` controls:

- island discovery root in build/dev
- dev `/_ssr` directory used by adapters

Use this when entrypoint package differs from island package location.

## Hono helper

`createSSRHandler(html)` enables pages as:

```tsx
export default ssr(async (c) => {
  c.get("page").title = "Home";
  return <Page />;
});
```

Supports middlewares/validators before final handler.

## Local example app

See `packages/ssr-example` for the current reference setup.

Useful workspace commands (from repo root):

```bash
bun run test
bun run dev:example
bun run build:example
```
